content_data.meeting_title: Logistics Automation Strategy Alignment - Phase 2 Review
agenda_items: Risk assessment and mitigation strategies for technology integration
Discussion of current bottlenecks in regional distribution centers (DCs)
Review of Phase 1 automation implementation outcomes and KPIs
Defining success metrics for Phase 2 initiatives
Resource allocation and budget considerations for the upcoming period
Proposed automation technologies for Phase 2 (e.g., AGVs, advanced WMS modules)
key_decisions: Allocate additional budget for specialized WMS integration consultants.
Prioritize AGV deployment in two high-volume regional DCs for the next 6 months.
attendees: Mr. Samuel Akintola, Regional DC Manager (East)
Dr. Anya Sharma, Head of Logistics Strategy
Ms. Emily Carter, Senior Management Consultant (Facilitator)
Ms. Isabella Rossi, Director of Supply Chain Technology
Mr. David Chen, VP Operations North America
